## Problem
You have two ropes. Each takes exactly an hour to burn, but they burn unevenly: half of a rope does not take half an hour. With a lighter and nothing else, how do you measure 45 minutes?

## Hints
1. A rope lit at both ends burns out in half an hour, however uneven it is. *(asked by Armen)*
2. You can light the second rope at different moments. *(asked by Aramayis)*
3. Start both ropes at the same moment. *(asked by Armen)*

## Solution
Light rope A at both ends and rope B at one end. When A burns out, 30 minutes have passed and B has 30 minutes left. Now light B's other end: it burns out 15 minutes later. **30 + 15 = 45 minutes.**

## Notes
We both got stuck on cutting the ropes in half, which doesn't work because they burn unevenly.
